title: Data Scientist
must_have: 3+ years of experience in data science
text:
Data Scientist
Nilgiri Data Works | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a data scientist to join our data science team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Pandas
- Scikit-learn
- Feature Engineering
- SQL
- Python
- 3+ years of experience in data science

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Machine Learning
- A/B Testing
- PyTorch
- Airflow

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive demand planning revamp with measurable outcomes.
- Drive churn reduction programme with measurable outcomes.
- Drive fraud screening upgrade with measurable outcomes.
